title: Rauvolfia serpentina tincture for medicinal use
intro: Rauvolfia serpentina tincture is a herbal preparation made from the dried roots of the Rauvolfia serpentina plant, commonly known as Indian snakeroot. This tincture is traditionally used in herbalism for its sedative and antihypertensive properties. It is often employed to help manage symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and high blood pressure. The active compounds, such as reserpine, are believed to affect the central nervous system and reduce sympathetic activity. In modern herbal practice, it is used cautiously due to its potential for side effects and interactions with other medications.
